stanzas.sanskrit:
त्रिदशवर्धकिवर्धितकौशलं
त्रिदशदत्तसमस्तविभूतिमत् ।
जलधिमध्यगतं त्वमभूषयो
नवपुरं वपुरञ्चितरोचिषा ॥ ७८-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Even though Vishwakarma, the divine architect, put all his excellent skills to build Dwaraka in the middle of the sea & the divine Gods made it prosperous, it was beautified only by the presence of Krishna.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tridaśavardhakivardhitakauśalaṃ
tridaśadattasamastavibhūtimat |
jaladhimadhyagataṃ tvamabhūṣayo
navapuraṃ vapurañcitarociṣā || 78-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
ददुषि रेवतभूभृति रेवतीं
हलभृते तनयां विधिशासनात् ।
महितमुत्सवघोषमपूपुषः
समुदितैर्मुदितैः सह यादवैः ॥ ७८-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Under the instructions of Brahma, Revathan's son, gave his daughter Revati in marriage to Balaram. Krishna together with Yadavas happily performed a great festive celebration.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
daduṣi revatabhūbhṛti revatīṃ
halabhṛte tanayāṃ vidhiśāsanāt |
mahitamutsavaghoṣamapūpuṣaḥ
samuditairmuditaiḥ saha yādavaiḥ || 78-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अथ विदर्भसुतां खलु रुक्मिणीं
प्रणयिनीं त्वयि देव सहोदरः ।
स्वयमदित्सत चेदिमहीभुजे
स्वतमसा तमसाधुमुपाश्रयन् ॥ ७८-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The King of Vidarbha’s daughter Rukmini was in love with Krishna. But her brother Rukmi, in his total ignorance, decided to give his sister in marriage to Chedi king, Shishupala. Rukmi was friend with non-virtuous Shishupala.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
atha vidarbhasutāṃ khalu rukmiṇīṃ
praṇayinīṃ tvayi deva sahodaraḥ |
svayamaditsata cedimahībhuje
svatamasā tamasādhumupāśrayan || 78-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
चिरधृतप्रणया त्वयि बालिका
सपदि काङ्क्षितभङ्गसमाकुला ।
तव निवेदयितुं द्विजमादिश-
-त्स्वकदनं कदनङ्गविनिर्मितम् ॥ ७८-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Rukmini in deep love for Krishna for a long time, became upset over her brother's decision to marry her to Shishupala. She sent a Brahmin as messenger to Krishna, conveying her love and the pain due to the threat of non fulfillment of her wish to marry Krishna.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ciradhṛtapraṇayā tvayi bālikā
sapadi kāṅkṣitabhaṅgasamākulā |
tava nivedayituṃ dvijamādiśa-
-tsvakadanaṃ kadanaṅgavinirmitam || 78-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
द्विजसुतोऽपि च तूर्णमुपाययौ
तव पुरं हि दुराशदुरासदम् ।
मुदमवाप च सादरपूजितः
स भवता भवतापहृता स्वयम् ॥ ७८-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Dwaraka is not reachable for those with evil thoughts and actions but the Brahmin messenger reached it faster. Krishna, the one who removes the afflictions of worldly pleasures, welcomed and honoured him.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
dvijasuto’pi ca tūrṇamupāyayau
tava puraṃ hi durāśadurāsadam |
mudamavāpa ca sādarapūjitaḥ
sa bhavatā bhavatāpahṛtā svayam || 78-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
स च भवन्तमवोचत कुण्डिने
नृपसुता खलु राजति रुक्मिणी ।
त्वयि समुत्सुकया निजधीरता-
-रहितया हि तया प्रहितोऽस्म्यहम् ॥ ७८-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The brahmin messenger conveyed to Krishna that princess Rukmini is in love with HIM and has sent him to convey her mind.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sa ca bhavantamavocata kuṇḍine
nṛpasutā khalu rājati rukmiṇī |
tvayi samutsukayā nijadhīratā-
-rahitayā hi tayā prahito’smyaham || 78-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तव हृतास्मि पुरैव गुणैरहं
हरति मां किल चेदिनृपोऽधुना ।
अयि कृपालय पालय मामिति
प्रजगदे जगदेकपते तया ॥ ७८-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Knowing excellence of Krishna, Rukmini is attracted to Krishna. Now Chedi king Shishupala is planning to marry her. So she requested Krishna to intervene and protect her.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tava hṛtāsmi puraiva guṇairahaṃ
harati māṃ kila cedinṛpo’dhunā |
ayi kṛpālaya pālaya māmiti
prajagade jagadekapate tayā || 78-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अशरणां यदि मां त्वमुपेक्षसे
सपदि जीवितमेव जहाम्यहम् ।
इति गिरा सुतनोरतनोद्भृशं
सुहृदयं हृदयं तव कातरम् ॥ ७८-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Rukmini also conveyed that she would not live if Krishna fails to protect her. This message of Rukmini from the good hearted Brahmin, brought about deep agitation in Bhagwan’s heart.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
aśaraṇāṃ yadi māṃ tvamupekṣase
sapadi jīvitameva jahāmyaham |
iti girā sutanoratanodbhṛśaṃ
suhṛdayaṃ hṛdayaṃ tava kātaram || 78-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अकथयस्त्वमथैनमये सखे
तदधिका मम मन्मथवेदना ।
नृपसमक्षमुपेत्य हराम्यहं
तदयि तां दयितामसितेक्षणाम् ॥ ७८-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna conveyed that HE is equally in love with Rukmini and promised to the Brahmin that HE will come to Vidarbha and carry princess Rukmini in front of all the Kings assembled there.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
akathayastvamathainamaye sakhe
tadadhikā mama manmathavedanā |
nṛpasamakṣamupetya harāmyahaṃ
tadayi tāṃ dayitāmasitekṣaṇām || 78-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
प्रमुदितेन च तेन समं तदा
रथगतो लघु कुण्डिनमेयिवान् ।
गुरुमरुत्पुरनायक मे भवा-
-न्वितनुतां तनुतां निखिलापदाम् ॥ ७८-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna left to Kundina immediately with the Brahmin in the chariot. Bhattathiri worshipped Bhagwan to protect him from his afflictions.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pramuditena ca tena samaṃ tadā
rathagato laghu kuṇḍinameyivān |
gurumarutpuranāyaka me bhavā-
-nvitanutāṃ tanutāṃ nikhilāpadām || 78-10 ||
